name: hxn-gpu-webgpu
description: WebGPU for Haxe in the browser, on hxcpp and Ash compiled to wasm: devices, buffers, textures, bind groups, pipelines and command encoders
releasenote: In a threaded hxcpp build WebGPU runs in a browser agent, as under Ash, so await works on what the browser settles, under hxcpp and Ash alike. Needs hxn 0.3.6.
